# 2028 Health-Benefits Tracker

**Elected medical plan:** Helio 2028 Employee-Only HDHP  
**Coverage period:** January 1–December 31, 2028

## Plan and payroll details

| Item | Expected for 2028 | Actual year-end | Difference / notes |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Medical-plan payroll deductions | $98 × 24 paychecks = **$2,352** | $________ | $________ |
| Employee HSA payroll contributions | $125 × 24 paychecks = **$3,000** | $________ | $________ |
| Deductible | **$2,000** | $________ | $________ |
| Out-of-pocket maximum | **$4,000** | $________ | $________ |

## Employer HSA deposits

Four deposits of **$250 each**, scheduled for **January 15, April 15, July 15, and October 15, 2028**. Each deposit is **contingent on remaining HSA-eligible on that deposit date**; it is not guaranteed or paid upfront.

| Scheduled date | Expected | Eligibility on deposit date? | Actual deposit | Difference / notes |
|---|---:|---|---:|---|
| January 15, 2028 | $250 | __________ | $________ | $________ |
| April 15, 2028 | $250 | __________ | $________ | $________ |
| July 15, 2028 | $250 | __________ | $________ | $________ |
| October 15, 2028 | $250 | __________ | $________ | $________ |
| **Employer HSA total** | **Up to $1,000, if eligible for all four deposits** |  | **$________** | **$________** |

## Year-end funding reconciliation

| Funding measure | Expected | Actual | Actual − expected / notes |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Employee HSA contributions | $3,000 | $________ | $________ |
| Employer HSA contributions | Up to $1,000, eligibility-contingent | $________ | $________ |
| **Combined HSA funding** | **Up to $4,000, if all four employer deposits are made** | **$________** | **$________** |
| Medical-plan payroll deductions | $2,352 | $________ | $________ |

**Year-end review:** Confirm payroll deduction counts and totals against pay statements; confirm each employer deposit and eligibility condition against HSA activity. Record any missed paycheck deductions, skipped/adjusted employer deposits, or other differences in the notes above.
